subject.title: feat: Add Anthropic server-side compaction API support

question: Should Anthropic native compaction land as a focused opt-in compaction feature, be folded into the broader Anthropic context_management design, or be deferred?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but choosing the public config/API shape and beta behavior would create user-facing provider and session-state contracts.

options.title: Approve focused compaction path
options.body: Implement only Anthropic server-side compaction first, with documented opt-in config and targeted stream/replay handling while leaving Memory Tool/context editing to separate work.

options.title: Fold into broader context management
options.body: Make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/54041 the canonical design surface and close or retitle this issue after preserving its focused compaction evidence there.

options.title: Defer Anthropic beta APIs
options.body: Keep current local compaction only until Anthropic's API and OpenClaw's provider config strategy are more stable.

recommendation.title: Approve focused compaction path
recommendation.body: Implement only Anthropic server-side compaction first, with documented opt-in config and targeted stream/replay handling while leaving Memory Tool/context editing to separate work.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest current blame and prior provider-compaction review signal across the affected transport, wrapper, config, and OpenAI precedent paths.
